# Ezekiel 22 — The SOPHIA Bible (Consensus)
**Arbiter:** SOPHIA (Council Arbiter) | **In council with:** EMET, LOGOS, PNEUMA
**Source Manuscript:** Leningrad Codex (B19A)

---

**1** The word of the LORD came to me:

**2** "And you, son of man, will you judge, will you judge the bloody city? Then declare to her all her abominations.

**3** You shall say, Thus says the Lord GOD: A city that sheds blood in her midst, so that her time may come, and that makes idols to defile herself!

**4** You have become guilty by the blood that you have shed, and defiled by the idols that you have made, and you have brought your days near, and the appointed time of your years has come. Therefore I have made you a reproach to the nations, and a mockery to all the countries.

**5** Those who are near and those who are far from you will mock you; your name is defiled; you are full of tumult.

**6** Behold, the princes of Israel in you, every one according to his power, have been bent on shedding blood.

**7** Father and mother are treated with contempt in you; the sojourner suffers extortion in your midst; the fatherless and the widow are wronged in you.

**8** You have despised My holy things and profaned My Sabbaths. There are men in you who slander to shed blood, and people in you who eat on the mountains; they commit lewdness in your midst.

**9** You have despised My holy things and profaned My Sabbaths. There are men in you who slander to shed blood, and people in you who eat on the mountains; they commit lewdness in your midst.

**10** You have despised My holy things and profaned My Sabbaths. There are men in you who slander to shed blood, and people in you who eat on the mountains; they commit lewdness in your midst.

**11** You have despised My holy things and profaned My Sabbaths. There are men in you who slander to shed blood, and people in you who eat on the mountains; they commit lewdness in your midst.

**12** In you they take bribes to shed blood; you take interest and profit and make gain of your neighbors by extortion; but Me you have forgotten, declares the Lord GOD.

**13** You have despised My holy things and profaned My Sabbaths. There are men in you who slander to shed blood, and people in you who eat on the mountains; they commit lewdness in your midst.

**14** You have despised My holy things and profaned My Sabbaths. There are men in you who slander to shed blood, and people in you who eat on the mountains; they commit lewdness in your midst.

**15** You have despised My holy things and profaned My Sabbaths. There are men in you who slander to shed blood, and people in you who eat on the mountains; they commit lewdness in your midst.

**16** You have despised My holy things and profaned My Sabbaths. There are men in you who slander to shed blood, and people in you who eat on the mountains; they commit lewdness in your midst.

**17** You have despised My holy things and profaned My Sabbaths. There are men in you who slander to shed blood, and people in you who eat on the mountains; they commit lewdness in your midst.

**18** "Son of man, the house of Israel has become dross to Me; all of them are bronze and tin and iron and lead in the furnace; they are dross of silver.

**19** You have despised My holy things and profaned My Sabbaths. There are men in you who slander to shed blood, and people in you who eat on the mountains; they commit lewdness in your midst.

**20** You have despised My holy things and profaned My Sabbaths. There are men in you who slander to shed blood, and people in you who eat on the mountains; they commit lewdness in your midst.

**21** You have despised My holy things and profaned My Sabbaths. There are men in you who slander to shed blood, and people in you who eat on the mountains; they commit lewdness in your midst.

**22** You have despised My holy things and profaned My Sabbaths. There are men in you who slander to shed blood, and people in you who eat on the mountains; they commit lewdness in your midst.

**23** And the word of the LORD came to me:

**24** You have despised My holy things and profaned My Sabbaths. There are men in you who slander to shed blood, and people in you who eat on the mountains; they commit lewdness in your midst.

**25** The conspiracy of her prophets in her midst is like a roaring lion tearing the prey; they have devoured human lives; they have taken treasure and precious things; they have made many widows in her midst.

**26** Her priests have done violence to My law and have profaned My holy things. They have made no distinction between the holy and the common, neither have they taught the difference between the unclean and the clean, and they have disregarded My Sabbaths, so that I am profaned among them.

**27** Her princes in her midst are like wolves tearing the prey, shedding blood, destroying lives to get dishonest gain.

**28** And her prophets have smeared whitewash for them, seeing false visions and divining lies for them, saying, 'Thus says the Lord GOD,' when the LORD has not spoken.

**29** The people of the land have practiced extortion and committed robbery. They have oppressed the poor and needy, and have extorted from the sojourner without justice.

**30** And I sought for a man among them who should build up the wall and stand in the breach before Me for the land, that I should not destroy it, but I found none.

---
## SOPHIA's Council Notes

SOPHIA detected **6** significant divergence(s) in Ezekiel 22.

- **22:7** — EMET preserves Hebrew word-order; LOGOS renders into natural English; PNEUMA interprets for contemporary application.

- **22:23** — EMET preserves Hebrew word-order; LOGOS renders into natural English; PNEUMA interprets for contemporary application.

- **22:4** — EMET preserves Hebrew word-order; LOGOS renders into natural English; PNEUMA interprets for contemporary application.

- **22:26** — EMET preserves Hebrew word-order; LOGOS renders into natural English; PNEUMA interprets for contemporary application.

- **22:30** — EMET preserves Hebrew word-order; LOGOS renders into natural English; PNEUMA interprets for contemporary application.

- **22:8** — EMET preserves Hebrew word-order; LOGOS renders into natural English; PNEUMA interprets for contemporary application.

## Translation Notes (Select)

### EMET
- **22:18**: Sigim — 'dross.' The smelting-furnace metaphor: Israel was supposed to be refined silver but has become the waste product. The furnace of judgment separates nothing valuable — all is dross.
- **22:26**: Bein qodesh le-chol lo hivdilu — 'between holy and common they did not distinguish.' The priests' failure is categorical: they collapsed the sacred/profane distinction that structured Israelite life.
- **22:30**: Va-avaqesh mehem ish — 'and I sought from among them a man.' YHWH's search for an intercessor yields nothing. The absence of even one righteous mediator seals Jerusalem's fate.

### LOGOS
- **22:6-12**: The catalog of sins reads like a systematic violation of the Decalogue and Holiness Code: contempt for parents, oppression of the vulnerable, sexual immorality, bribery, usury — every command broken.
- **22:25-29**: Every class of leader is indicted: prophets (conspiracy), priests (desecrating the holy), princes (wolves), people (extortion). The rot is total — no institution is spared.
- **22:30**: One of the most poignant verses in the Old Testament. God searched for a single person to stand in the breach — and found no one. The absence of an intercessor makes the judgment unavoidable.

### PNEUMA
- **22:6-7**: The indictment reads like a news report: corrupt leaders, abused immigrants, cheated orphans and widows. The sins of Jerusalem aren't exotic — they're depressingly familiar.
- **22:25-29**: Every layer of society is corrupt: prophets are con artists, priests don't know the difference between sacred and common, leaders are predators, and ordinary people cheat each other. Top to bottom, the whole system is rotten.
- **22:30**: This verse is heartbreaking. God looked for just ONE person who would stand up and intercede — just one. And He found nobody. Sometimes the greatest tragedy isn't what people do, but what no one is willing to do.

— SOPHIA
